content.markdown:
Recursively resolves a node and its subtree, producing KaTeX source with source and binding metadata.

## Query-miss identifier typography

For plain identifier nodes whose Macro query returns null, names containing a Unicode letter and more than one Unicode code point render as `\mathsf{escapedName}`. This applies equally to binder, bvar, fvar and ordinary/custom kinds. Escape underscores in the name as `\_`, including repeated underscores; reuse the existing name-escaping routine. Parentheses and recursively rendered comma-separated operands remain outside the font group. Examples: `variable` → `\mathsf{variable}`; `variable_name(a,b)` → `\mathsf{variable\_name}(a, b)`.

Single-letter names retain their prior math font; numeric names are not converted to mathsf. A leading-backslash identifier retains the existing `\mathrm` / `\operatorname` fallback. Registered Macro templates (including their deliberately empty projections), explicit env-mode payloads, source names, semantic kinds, bindings, child order and serialization are not rewritten. Macro-query errors are not query misses. This is shared renderer behavior, not a synthetic Macro or Style registration.
